meta.title: Lowercase tags; drop method body
meta.body_summary: Remove the 'body' field from Method in the C# AST inspector and regenerate all C# golden AST files without it, reducing serialized AST size.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit tool update: drop unused Method body from C# AST inspector and regenerate golden files; author self-merged instantly with no review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 26,865 changed lines across 104 files, this is a very large change by absolute volume. However, only 64 lines are in the production inspector code; the rest are mechanical regeneration of 103 golden AST test files to drop a single 'body' field from each Method node. This is a low-risk mechanical change that fits a fast-track performance refactor and was merged without review.

review_details.performance_claim: Reduce AST serialization overhead by dropping unused 'body' field from Method nodes.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Mechanically dropping a redundant field from a code inspector and regenerating test fixtures is well within agent capability; no maintainer feedback was needed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides test commands (`go test -update`) but no before/after performance metrics or profiling.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression issues; merged without review.

core_change_summary.description: In tools/json-ast/x/cs/inspect.go, removed the `body` slice from the Method node serialization and lowercased the tag name. Regenerated all 103 golden AST test files under tests/json-ast/x/cs/ to reflect the removal of the `body` field.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All 103 golden test files were regenerated to drop the `body` field from Method nodes; no semantic changes.
change_trajectory: Single commit removed `body` from Method and lowercased tag in inspect.go, then ran `go test -update` to regenerate all golden AST files.

collaboration_trajectory: Author self-merged immediately with no review or comments.
